title: Cavolo Nero with Hazelnut Pesto Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 20g of Parmesan, grated (use a similar hard cheese made with vegetarian rennet, if preferred)
400g of cavolo nero, trimmed, thick stalks cut out
ldInstructionsRaw: Begin by toasting the hazelnuts. Place the nuts on a baking tray in an even single layer and toast in the oven for 5 minutes. Check, stir and toast for a further 3 minutes until golden brown
Allow the nuts to cool then transfer to a blender with the garlic, Parmesan and hazelnut oil. Blitz to a coarse pesto, taste, and season with salt and pepper
Blanch the cavolo nero in salted boiling water for 3 minutes
Drain and toss with the pesto and a squeeze of lemon. Season to taste
